notes.title: Patch 1.3!!!
notes.content:
-Better translation of the game in English (Thanks to Macktek)
-Fixes some light and level bugs

Thank you all for your support and a special thanks to Macktek!

notes.title: New game update in progress
notes.content:
A friend of mine (Macktek) is working on a much better translation for the game than the one that the game has in english. When it's ready, I'll update it in-game and it'll be available on Steam for free. Thanks to everyone for your support!!!

And especially thanks to my friend for the translation, without him it would not be possible. thank you
